user.title: Choose device A
user.description: Choose four entities from the first stock Voice Preview device. Use its Media Player and first Assistant selector.

device_b.title: Choose device B
device_b.description: Choose the matching entities from the second stock Voice Preview device.

network.title: Home Assistant address
network.description: Enter the Home Assistant LAN URL that both devices can reach, including its port. The demo streams incoming call audio from this address.

error.invalid_device: Choose existing ESPHome entities of the requested types.
error.mixed_devices: All four entities must belong to the same device.
error.not_pipeline_selector: Choose the first Assistant selector, rather than a wake-word or sensitivity selector.
error.same_device: Choose a different device for the other end of the call.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL with a host and optional port, without a path, credentials, or query.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The demo supports one pair. Remove the existing entry to choose different devices.

init.title: Home Assistant address
init.description: Changing this address ends any current call.
